verdict.rationale: Grok Build's own docs show pieces of a debugging loop: the agent explores the codebase, runs commands in the background, monitors logs or CI output, and can re-run prompts such as test-suite checks. File snapshots also let you roll back attempted fixes. However, there is no documented workflow for reproducing bugs or isolating root causes; these are general agent capabilities applied to debugging. Missing for 10: documented issue-reproduction workflow, root-cause narrowing guidance, explicit fix-verification feature, and hands-on or independent corroboration of debugging effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.
Grok can run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues.
/loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures
each line the script prints becomes a notification in the conversation. Ask for one when you want to watch a log, a CI run, or a port
Selecting one restores all files to their state at that point and truncates the conversation to match.
